summary: Recent discussions in the Iceberg community have focused on enhancements to the REST specification, including proposals for batch load endpoints and fine-grained access control. Additionally, the community is exploring improvements in Iceberg-Spark integration and the introduction of collation support in the Iceberg specification.
highlights: Iceberg-Spark integration work and async reader improvements
Proposal for collation support in Iceberg specification
Discussion on batch load endpoints in REST spec
Efforts to improve column update efficiency in Iceberg
